title: Website Screenshot API - Bulk Full Page PNG/JPEG from URLs
desc: Website screenshot API for a list of URLs: full page, viewport or one element (CSS selector), PNG or JPEG, desktop, tablet or mobile, dark mode, cookie banners hidden. $0.002 per screenshot ($2 per 1,000); failed or unreachable URLs free.

title: Audio & Video Transcriber (Whisper) - MP3/MP4 to Text, SRT, VTT
desc: Whisper speech-to-text transcriber for audio, video and podcast RSS feeds: MP3, M4A, WAV, MP4 to text, SRT and VTT, with speaker labels, timestamps and 99 languages. $0.005 per audio minute; failed links and silent files are free. No API key.

title: Greenhouse, Lever & Ashby Jobs Scraper - Personio & more
desc: Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Personio, Teamtailor and Recruitee jobs scraper: all open jobs from company career pages via official ATS feeds. Auto-detects the ATS from a company website. $1 per 1,000 jobs; companies without a supported ATS and filtered jobs free.

title: Workday Jobs Scraper - Any myworkdayjobs.com Careers Site
desc: Workday jobs scraper for any Workday career site (myworkdayjobs.com): full description, exact posting date, location, country and remote type. Filters and new-job monitoring. $0.80 per 1,000 jobs; inputs without a Workday site and filtered jobs free.

title: TED Tenders Scraper - EU Public Procurement & Awards
desc: TED (Tenders Electronic Daily) scraper for EU public tenders and contract awards via the official API: keywords, CPV, countries, deadlines, values and winners. Only-new alerts. $2.50 per 1,000 notices; already-seen notices free, no login.

title: EU Grants Scraper - Horizon Europe & EU Funding Calls
desc: EU grants and funding calls from the official EU Funding & Tenders Portal: Horizon Europe, Digital Europe, LIFE, Erasmus+ and cascade funding, with real status, deadlines and a minimum budget filter. $3 per 1,000 calls; filtered and already-seen calls free.

title: TenderNed Scraper - Dutch Public Tenders & Procurement API
desc: TenderNed Netherlands public tenders scraper via the official keyless API (CC0) to JSON, CSV or Excel. Keywords, dates, CPV and daily only-new alerts. ~$2.50 per 1,000 notices; failed or empty runs and already-seen notices are free.
